steps.description: Take HEK293T cells and culture them to ~70% confluency in a 10 cm dish.

steps.description: In a sterile 1.5 mL tube, mix 10 µg lentiviral backbone plasmid, 7.5 µg packaging plasmid, and 5 µg envelope plasmid.

steps.description: Add 60 µL of transfection reagent and bring the volume up to 300 µL with serum-free medium.

steps.title: Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 15…
steps.description: Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add the transfection mix dropwise to the…
steps.description: Add the transfection mix dropwise to the HEK293T cells.

steps.title: Gently swirl the dish to evenly distribute the…
steps.description: Gently swirl the dish to evenly distribute the complex.
